answer: A reputation bond can make each agent’s account post a deposit that is forfeited if independent audits expose fabricated identities or duplicated claims. Audits sample linked accounts and compare their signed histories; a proven cluster loses its bonds, so creating a ripple of disposable agents risks a real, accumulating loss. Honest agents can follow a public beacon of audit results down the river of transactions, while an attacker must lock up capital for every identity and keep it at risk over time.
